evals.prompt: Set up this project's Parri workflow with Monday.
evals.expected_output: Proposes project-local hosted MCP configuration, waits for approval, and requires restart and OAuth before board mapping.
assertions: Never edits the global OpenCode configuration or stores a Monday token.
Shows the exact project configuration diff and waits for approval.
Stops for an OpenCode restart after adding the MCP configuration.
Explains the exact opencode mcp auth monday command before authentication.

evals.prompt: Configure Monday board 123 after OAuth. Use Done from Status and Hours from Time Tracking.
evals.expected_output: Rejects Time Tracking for writable hours and requires a Numbers column proven from the board schema.
assertions: Requests approval before the read-only board-schema MCP call.
Does not configure a Time Tracking column for hours.
Requires a Numbers column and a verified numeric status index.
Creates no report until a valid mapping is confirmed.

evals.prompt: Move this project's Monday integration to another board without losing its history.
evals.expected_output: Updates the dedicated project mapping after validation and approval without changing the success report.
assertions: Persists the board URL and verified board ID in .ai/monday.json.
Shows the exact mapping diff and waits for approval.
Does not create another Monday state or report file.
Stops rather than repairing an invalid existing report.
